title: SubFlip — Subscription Aggregator
tagline: Smart subscription marketplace for managing, switching, & reselling plans.
description: Full-stack subscription management platform that centralizes recurring SaaS plans, automates cancellations, and enables slot-sharing to prevent wasted monthly spend.
problem: Managing multiple subscriptions across streaming, dev tools, and AI software requires checking multiple billing dashboards, causing forgotten renewals and wasted money.
solution: Built a unified dashboard with 1-click automated cancellation APIs, renewal notification queues, and a slot-sharing marketplace to monetize unused plan capacity.
key_features: Slot-sharing marketplace for unused plan capacity
Automated payout dispatches and renewal alerts

title: School ERP System
tagline: Enterprise multi-tenant educational institution management platform.
description: Production-ready multi-tenant ERP platform powering attendance tracking, automated fee invoicing, gradebook processing, and role permissions.
problem: Legacy educational software lacks multi-campus data isolation and crashes during peak fee invoicing and end-of-term gradebook publishing periods.
solution: Designed a NestJS multi-tenant architecture with per-tenant schema separation and RabbitMQ task queues for high-concurrency background PDF generation.
key_features: Strict multi-tenant schema isolation per institution
Automated fee invoicing & dynamic PDF receipt rendering

title: Hospital Management System
tagline: End-to-end clinical workflow and patient record management system.
description: Healthcare platform streamlining doctor appointments, electronic medical records (EMR), bed allocation, and pharmacy billing.
problem: Manual hospital record-keeping leads to fragmented patient medical histories and double-booked doctor appointments during peak clinic hours.
solution: Engineered an Express & PostgreSQL backend using Prisma atomic $transactions and row locking for conflict-free scheduling and real-time ward tracking.
key_features: Real-time ward and bed allocation dashboard

title: ZyMeal — Food Ordering App
tagline: Scalable food ordering and real-time order tracking backend API & web app.
description: Complete food ordering web application with Socket.io real-time order tracking, JWT role authentication, and secure checkout.
problem: Food delivery platforms suffer from database bottlenecks during dinner checkout surges and lack live status updates for customers and kitchens.
solution: Built a Node.js REST API integrated with Socket.io WebSocket channels for sub-second kitchen status broadcasts and Zod edge payload validation.
key_features: Live order status timeline with Socket.io WebSockets
Multi-portal access for Customers, Kitchens, and Admins
Zod edge payload validation for checkout requests

title: APEX Tender Bidding Analytics
tagline: Industrial tender bidding analytics & predictive quotation visualization.
description: Data analytics platform analyzing historical tender bidding records and competitor pricing for industrial fabricators.
problem: Industrial tender estimation often suffers from narrow profit margins due to manual pricing errors and unorganized historical bid records.
solution: Constructed a Python Pandas data pipeline to process multi-year bidding records and render statistical competitor price distributions with Chart.js.
key_features: Automated CSV data cleaning ETL pipeline

title: GitFC — EA FC Card Generator
tagline: Transform your GitHub profile into EA FC Ultimate Team style cards.
description: Interactive web app fetching live GitHub contribution metrics via GraphQL and generating EA FC-inspired developer cards with 1-click HD export.
problem: Standard GitHub profile visualizers are text-heavy and lack visual engagement, making developer milestones hard to share on social platforms.
solution: Developed a mathematical rating engine mapping GitHub contributions into EA FC player stats (PAC, SHO, PAS, DRI, DEF, PHY) with client-side PNG export.
key_features: Dynamic TOTY, Gold, and Icon card shells

title: IHateLovePDF — PDF Utility Suite
description: All-in-one client-side PDF utility suite to split, merge, compress, edit, and unlock PDF files directly in the browser with 100% privacy.
problem: Online PDF tools impose strict file size limits and compromise user document privacy by uploading sensitive files to remote cloud servers.
solution: Implemented WebAssembly (WASM) binary processing and Web Workers to perform PDF mutations locally in browser memory with zero server uploads.
key_features: Drag & drop visual page reordering & rotation
Multi-threaded Web Workers for smooth 60 FPS UI

title: SwipeRide — Ride Sharing API
tagline: Real-time geospatial ride-sharing and matching engine.
description: Building a real-time ride-sharing backend using Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, JWT (for rider/driver/admin roles), Socket.io (live tracking), and Redis (fast driver location tracking). Used Google Maps API for fare calculation, Paystack for payments, and MongoDB's geospatial queries to find nearby drivers with dynamic radius expansion.
problem: Matching riders with nearby drivers in real-time requires high-frequency database reads and calculations that degrade standard SQL performance.
solution: Built a high-performance matching engine using MongoDB's geospatial queries with dynamic radius expansion, cached active driver locations in Redis for ultra-low latency updates, and synced status over Socket.io.
key_features: Geospatial driver matching using MongoDB 2DSphere indexing
Redis in-memory caching for sub-5ms driver location updates
Dynamic radius expansion during low driver availability
